text: At the April meeting of Toronto and East York Community Council, amendments to parking regulations on Dufferin Park Avenue were aimed at improving parking availability for residents, visitors, and Park and Recreation staff. While the adopted parking regulations created additional on-street parking spaces, they also created unintended parking challenges on the north side of Dufferin Park Avenue, particularly for residents with accessible parking permits. The recommendations below will correct these regulations and continue to support the goal of improving parking availability for this community.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Re-opened Item 2026.TE32.42 titled "Expanding Parking Availability on Dufferin Park Avenue”. 2. Deleted Part 3 of its decision on Item 2026.TE32.42 and adopted the following instead: a. Delete the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the north side of Dufferin Park Avenue, between Dufferin Street and the east end. b. Delete the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Dufferin Park Avenue, between Dufferin Street and a point 15 metres east. c. Delete the existing parking prohibition in effect at all times on the south side of Dufferin Park Avenue, between a point 43 metres east of Dufferin Street and the east end. d. Prohibit parking at all times on the north side of Dufferin Park Avenue, between Dufferin Street and a point 42 metres east. e. Prohibit stopping at all times on the north side…
